text: In London the shy focus puller Mark Lewis [films women as he kills them|threat|people who kill] with [a blade hidden in his tripod's leg|images|weapons and tools], then watches the footage alone in his darkroom. He lives in his late father's house, and old home films show that [his father used him as a boy to study fear|wrong|harm done to children]. When Helen, the kind young woman in the flat below, befriends him, her blind mother senses something wrong, and the [mirror mounted on his camera|images|mirrors and glass] waits for its next face.
